record_title: Prime-indicator parity in Tunnell-type comparison progressions
provenance: Genus-theoretic and binary quadratic-form analysis of the ternary comparison coefficients in Section 7 of Im--Shin's Tunnell-type criteria.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint arXiv:2609.19085v1 is extremely recent, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. The classical three-square, genus-theory, and binary quadratic-form ingredients are not claimed as new. The theorem is specific to the published comparison residue sets: outside them r_135(n)/4 can be odd for square-free composites, as n=39 and n=111 show. The extra (1+i)-divisibility does not imply Fourier-coefficient vanishing and does not itself produce a new family of composite theta-congruent or non-theta-congruent numbers. The finite exact-integer verification supports but does not replace the proof. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
